title: The Faithful Have Vanished

questions.question: Save, O Lord, for the godly one is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:1 (ESV): "Save, O Lord, for the godly one is gone;"

questions.question: Everyone utters lies to his neighbor; with flattering lips and a double what they speak?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:2 (ESV): "Everyone utters lies to his neighbor; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak."

questions.question: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that makes great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:3 (ESV): "May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that makes great boasts,"

questions.question: The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified how many times?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:6 (ESV): "The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven times."

questions.question: You, O Lord, will keep them; you will guard us from this generation when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:7 (ESV): "You, O Lord, will keep them; you will guard us from this generation forever."

questions.question: Because the poor are plundered, because the needy groan, I will now what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:5 (ESV): "Because the poor are plundered, because the needy groan, I will now arise," says the Lord."

questions.question: I will place him in the safety for which he does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:5 (ESV): "...I will place him in the safety for which he longs."

questions.question: On every side the wicked prowl, as vileness is exalted among the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:8 (ESV): "On every side the wicked prowl, as vileness is exalted among the children of man."

questions.question: Those who say, "With our tongue we will prevail, our lips are with us; who is master over us?" are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:3-4 (ESV): Context implies these are the boastful wicked.

questions.question: The faithful have vanished from among whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:1 (ESV): "...for the faithful have vanished from among the children of man."

questions.question: This Psalm is according to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12 Title: "To the choirmaster: according to The Sheminith. A Psalm of David."

questions.question: Vileness is exalted among whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:8 (ESV): "...as vileness is exalted among the children of man."

questions.question: Who says, "I will now arise"?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:5 (ESV): "...I will now arise," says the Lord."

questions.question: Like silver refined in a what on the ground?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:6 (ESV): "...like silver refined in a furnace on the ground,"

questions.question: They speak with what kind of lips?
questions.explanation: Psalm 12:2 (ESV): "...with flattering lips and a double heart they speak."

key_verse_text: The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven times.
